steps.en: Scaffold a Vite project, or drop the CDN build into an existing page
steps.zh: 生成一个 Vite 项目，或者把 CDN 版本直接放进现有页面

steps.en: Write a component: an HTML-like template plus the reactive values it shows
steps.zh: 写组件：一段类 HTML 模板，加上它要显示的响应式值

steps.en: Create the app and mount it on one element
steps.zh: 创建应用，挂到一个元素上

steps.en: Compiles the template and records which reactive values each component reads while rendering
steps.zh: 编译模板，渲染时记下每个组件读了哪些响应式值

component.zh: 模板编译器 + 响应式系统

steps.en: When a value changes, re-renders only the components that read it and patches the DOM
steps.zh: 某个值一变，只重渲染读了它的组件，并把差异补到 DOM 上

value.en: You change data; Vue already knows which parts of the page depend on it, so you never write update code or tune re-renders
value.zh: 你只改数据；哪些界面依赖它 Vue 早就记下了，不用写更新代码，也不用调重渲染

sources: https://vuejs.org/guide/quick-start.html (npm create vue@latest; CDN build with createApp, ref and .mount('#app'))
https://github.com/vuejs/core/blob/minor/CHANGELOG.md (3.6: Vapor mode via <script setup vapor>, alien-signals reactivity refactor)
